name: Dr. Osei
bio: Knows every plant on Earth by sight. Has opinions about all of them. Does not like what is growing on the derelict.

passive_skill.description: Crop health events resolve more favorably. Crop water consumption reduced 15%.

active_skill.name: Greenhouse Protocol
active_skill.description: Stabilize a sick crop — restore 15 crop health. One use per leg.

narrative_unlocks: Plant identification choices in derelict and planet events
Modified descriptions when examining alien biology — she knows what she's looking at and doesn't like it
Zinnia Arc beat variations — professionally embarrassed by how much she cares

name: Kazuki
bio: Fixes things. Eats twice as much. Nobody has asked why.

passive_skill.description: Hull repair events cost less time and resources. Fabricator wear reduced by 20%.

active_skill.name: Emergency Patch
active_skill.description: Prevent 1 hull damage event per leg. Also enables improvised fabricator repair.

narrative_unlocks: Improvised fabricator repair path — no parts cost, partial restoration, can fail
Mechanical event options with better outcomes
Derelict salvage events — knows what's worth taking

name: Dr. Vasquez
bio: Chronically anxious. Excellent at their job. Do not ask about their residency.

passive_skill.description: Severity rolls improved — injury instead of lethal more often. Injured crew recover faster.

severity_modifier.notes: 30% chance a lethal outcome downgrades to injury when medic is aboard

active_skill.name: Treatment
active_skill.description: Heal one injured crew member — restore to healthy. One use per leg.

narrative_unlocks: Medical treatment choices that aren't available without a medic
Defibrillator microgame target zones doubled
Zinnia Arc — documents the measurable morale improvement in her logs

name: Reeves
bio: Overconfident. Statistically correct 78% of the time. Keeps a tally.

passive_skill.description: Fuel efficiency improved — engine burn reduced 10%. Calibration microgame drift reduced.

active_skill.name: Push Engines
active_skill.description: Skip a node at double fuel cost. Sometimes you need to be somewhere else.

narrative_unlocks: Evasive maneuver choices with reduced fuel cost
Nebula navigation minigame bonus — tighter controls
Can identify ship signatures on long-range scans

name: Reyes
bio: The most important person on the ship. They know it.

passive_skill.description: Food lasts longer — consumption reduced 15%. Passive morale +1 from actual meals.

active_skill.name: Special Meal
active_skill.description: Restore 10 morale using food reserves. Worth it.

narrative_unlocks: Food-based morale recovery events
Chef's Secret Project — suspicious fungus + chef = artisanal space cheese
Edibility judgment on unknown planet specimens — 'this is food' vs 'this is not food'

name: Dr. Tanaka
bio: Deeply excited about everything that could kill them. This is either bravery or a problem.

passive_skill.description: Anomaly and alien events have additional safe options. Biological sample analysis available.

active_skill.name: Field Analysis
active_skill.description: Analyze one unknown biological item or specimen — reveals properties before committing. One use per leg.

narrative_unlocks: Diplomatic option at the deep space anomaly (requires alien_seed_pod + xenobiologist)
Hidden choice to take biological samples at derelict stations
Alien encounter options that don't end in shooting

name: Hargrove
bio: Absolutely useless in every situation except the one specific situation. That situation comes up more than you'd think.

passive_skill.description: No passive stat bonus. They'd call it 'strategic patience.'

active_skill.name: Negotiation
active_skill.description: Unlock peaceful resolution in hostile/pirate events. Also occasionally talk stations into better deals.

narrative_unlocks: Negotiation_wobble microgame only appears with diplomat aboard
Peaceful resolution options in pirate/hostile encounters
Station reputation improves — better recruitment pool
